summary: HCA Healthcare, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on July 29, 2026, announcing that its wholly-owned subsidiary HCA Inc. increased its commercial paper program from $4.0 billion to $8.0 billion outstanding at any time. The notes are unsecured and unconditionally guaranteed by the parent. The filing is a routine update regarding a direct financial obligation, with no change to other program terms. This is not a special situation; it is an ordinary corporate liquidity management action that does not involve a merger, acquisition, restructuring, or other special-situation event.
